Background

Born Ekuban Emmanuel, Nuel Bans began his journey in fashion as a model and fashion assistant, developing an eye for style and storytelling from the ground up. That hands-on foundation shaped his deeply human approach to creative direction.

Mission

Through Debonair Afrik and The Style Lounge, Nuel champions African fashion on the world stage — scouting emerging talent, driving editorial narratives around heritage and sustainability, and building bridges between African creativity and global institutions including UNESCO and the V&A Museum.

Vision

A future where African fashion is not an afterthought but a defining force in global culture — where designers from Accra, Lagos, and Nairobi command the same stages as those from Paris and Milan.
